quest.title: A Few Words in the Foreground
quest.description: There's a performance going on at the North Wharf. Don't hesitate to come along if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "A performance going on at the North Wharf." Hmm... this notice is so vague. It doesn't say what the show is or who's gonna perform in it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders where the location is. But if we can't find it, we could always ask people on the street.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's a lot of people there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Paimon also sees it. Whoa, so many people are gathered there, maybe just for the show!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there going to be a performance here soon?

dialogues.speaker: Qingxing
dialogues.text: Yes, there's going to be a paper play. Are you guys here for it, too?

choices.text: So this opera is called "Paper Play."

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: No, paper plays and Liyue Operas are not the same thing...

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Qingxing! The show is about to begin. Be quiet, or you'll affect the performance.

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: Sorry! As for the paper play, you'll know it when you see it.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Honored guests, we will be performing "Bravebeard" today.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Before the show, if you want to head to the restroom, or grab a beverage, now's a good time. We will wait for no one when the show begins.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (So this performance is actually called "Bravebeard." But Paimon has never heard of this story.)

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Shh! We can still hear you even at a whisper. Keep it down. You can talk during intermission-selection.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... sorry.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Intermission-selection?

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: The story of the Bravebeard is quite long. In fact, it'd be too long to do it all in one go, so Yinggong will let the audience pick which scene they want to see during an intermission...

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Qingxing! I'm trying to listen to the play!

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: Oh, I won't butt in anymore, I promise.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: ...so, dear guests, what part of the Bravebeard's story would you like to see today?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Would you like to see "Mountain-Bound" or "Worshiping Adepti"? Maybe "Exorcising Demons"? Or "Ascension"?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: As long as you can name it, I can perform it!

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: I want to see the Bravebeard fight monsters! He is so handsome and wins every time.

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: You've seen "Worshiping Adepti" and "Exorcising Demons" so many times already. Haven't you got tired of it? I want to see the part where the Bravebeard goes home to see his sister.

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: The Bravebeard has a sister? How have I not heard of this? I definitely haven't seen that before.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: How impressive! Not many people would request "Homecoming." After all, only the real fans know about it.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Alright, just in time for Lantern Rite, we will not perform the plots featuring monsters. We shall spin a tale of how lovers end up together.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: There are three characters who shall appear in this scene. Aside from our Bravebeard, with whom you are familiar, of course. There is also a lonely girl named Yibing and an honest gentleman named Nanfeng.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Do you understand any of this, {NICKNAME}? Paimon's still confused...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this is a story about a guy called the "Bravebeard," right? It looks like there's a lot of supporting characters as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But so far there's only one performer on stage. Uh, and there's a... folding screen? How's it gonna work?

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Hey, someone here has never seen a paper play before.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Eh? Someone in the back asked how I, a lone performer, can be in different places at once and make this performance work?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Well, our paper plays may not be as exquisite as Liyue Operas, but we certainly have our own distinctive flavors.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: As you may know, the characters in Liyue Operas are portrayed by real people in the flesh, the actors in our performances, however, are portrayed with paper figures pasted on silk.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: And Liyue Operas take place on a large wooden stage, the stage for our performances, however, is but a paper screen on a wooden shelf. Our actors and stages are all made of paper, that's why we call it a paper play!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I am the narrator, but I am no actor. You will meet the three paper actors in just a moment.

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Yinggong, I don't think they know about the Bravebeard either. Would it be okay if you introduce them to his story? You know, the one you always start with...

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: That's called the establishing moment. I've always enjoyed that, too. Please perform it for us, Yinggong.

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Establishing moment! Establishing moment!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: It is said that the sky's the limit, but the woes of the world are also limitless.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: There was once a man named Huanguang, suffering from human injustice, who resorted to dwelling amongst the mountains and rivers.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: By chance, he became a disciple of an adeptus, changed his appearance, and grew a black beard. Thus, he is known as the "Bravebeard."

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: At the behest of the adeptus, he struck down monsters and scared off demons with his sword.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: The Bravebeard trained for many years and finally acquired the philosophy of the adeptus. Right before he returned to the adeptal abode, he was summoned to recall the past.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: It turned out that he still had an attachment to the common folk's society, where he had a sister at home. The poor sister, Yibing, was now alone and helpless.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: She thought that her brother had lived a miserable life, and never imagined that he would return home. As to what happened next...

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I shall show you, right away!

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: Hey, don't just stand there. Clap!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—Is there a rule about when we should clap? Ah, okay!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Thank you all. We are supposed to continue the show, but I can tell that these two guests are still a little perplexed.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I think it would be better if I ask these two to volunteer from the audience by coming forward and assisting me in directing the scene.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: It will give you both a good look, and it will help the actors move forward on this stage. What do you think?

response.speaker: Qingxing
response.text: Hey, why didn't you invite me? I know all about paper plays! You gotta remember to invite me, you just gotta!

response.speaker: Hesheng
response.text: You have been up there too many times already. Quit making a fuss and enjoy the show!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's fine by me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Help direct the scene? That sounds so novel. It's also fine by Paimon!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Then I shall ask you two to prepare. As soon as you two are in position, the performance will begin.
